description: Standalone code, metric records, 21 author-generated acoustic arrays, the attributed third-party thermal file, and all 85 current Table-1 weights for the FeatExtractNet round-two revision. Thermal HeatTransferData.npy is included with attribution; it retains original rights and is not relicensed. see DATA_SOURCES.md and LICENSES/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md.
